name: 鄭麗玲
objective:
本課程以衣食住行、飲食男女等日常活動、交往、思維為主軸，考察一般人的歷史活動與日常生活在各時期的變化。當歷史不再只是帝王將相的豐功偉業或名流大家的傳奇生活，升斗小民的日常生活看似微不足道，點點滴滴的匯聚而成的正是一個社會的大歷史。
This course focuses on everyday activities, social interactions, and paradigms of thought—encompassing basic necessities, dietary habits, and human relationships—to examine the historical actions and evolution of ordinary people's daily lives across various periods. History ceases to be defined solely by the monumental achievements of rulers and generals or the legendary lives of prominent figures. Instead, the daily lives of common people, though seemingly microscopic, aggregate piece by piece to constitute the macro-history of a society.
